mission.heading: The Enigma Protocol
paragraphs: Larkhaven is a fog-covered city of gaslight and telegraphs. The Code Bureau, beside the clock tower, guards the secrets of the whole city.
Tonight, Professor Alder Voss vanished from his study. His sealed plan, the Enigma Protocol, is missing from his desk.
You are Wren Ashby, his apprentice, with your friend Tobias Finch. Find out who took the Protocol before the clock tower strikes. You have ten minutes.

steps.text: Drag to look around the room.
Tap an object to look closer.
steps.ask: Tap the lamp, then close it with X.

steps.text: Tap glowing objects. Pick up the others.

Open the Casebook, then close it.

parts.text: Clues and solved puzzles earn Guineas. A wrong answer costs 5.
The clock stops only while Wren and Tobias talk.

opening.speaker: wren
opening.text: Tobias, the Professor's note said nine o'clock. The lamp is lit, but he isn't here.

opening.speaker: tobias
opening.text: He never leaves his study open. Not even for tea.

opening.speaker: wren
opening.text: The window is wide open too. Someone was here before us.

opening.speaker: tobias
opening.text: The Enigma Protocol is kept in that desk. It is the Bureau's biggest secret.

opening.speaker: wren
opening.text: Then we find it before the clock tower strikes. That gives us ten minutes.

opening.speaker: tobias
opening.text: Why ten? Oh. After that, the inspectors seal every door.

idle.speaker: tobias
idle.text: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

rooms.name: Voss's Study
rooms.objective: Find out who took the Protocol.

objectiveCard.title: Voss's Study
objectiveCard.text: Find out who took the Protocol.

enter.speaker: wren
enter.text: Look closely. Small things tell big stories.

enter.speaker: tobias
enter.text: Only four people hold Bureau passes. Mr. Hale, Mrs. Pell, Mr. Dunmore and Dr. Quill.

discuss.speaker: wren
discuss.text: Three clues, three facts about the thief.

discuss.speaker: tobias
discuss.text: So we match each clue to what it proves?

right.speaker: wren
right.text: The thief came in by the garden window. A left-handed writer who works inside the Bureau.

right.speaker: tobias
right.text: That could be one of four people. We need more.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: The Professor's drawer holds a telegraph token. Next door is the telegraph office.

card.title: Windowsill clay
views: Red clay is smeared across the sill. It is still damp.
Gritty garden mud, not carpet dust. Someone climbed in here.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Red clay on the sill. That is garden mud.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Clay. Garden. Window.

card.title: Left glove
views: A glove for the left hand. The fingertips are stained with ink.
The cuff is stained too. Its owner writes with this hand.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: A left glove with ink on the fingertips.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Left. Ink.

card.title: Torn note
views: A torn note lies by the fireplace.
Unfolded, it carries a round Bureau stamp in the corner.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: A Bureau stamp. This note came from inside.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Stamp. Inside.

card.title: The desk drawer
card.text: The drawer is empty. The Protocol is gone.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The drawer is empty. The Protocol is gone.

objectiveCard.title: Telegraph Office
objectiveCard.text: Someone sent a message here tonight. Open the message drawer.

enter.speaker: wren
enter.text: A telegraph office. Someone sent a message here tonight.

enter.speaker: tobias
enter.text: The drawer has a signal lock. It only listens to the key.

discuss.speaker: wren
discuss.text: The lamp flashes a pattern. We copy it on the key.

discuss.speaker: tobias
discuss.text: Short flash, quick tap. Long flash, long press.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: A telegram. The thief sent a decoy trunk by train.

right.speaker: tobias
right.text: After ten and before eleven, to send the Inspector the wrong way.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: The street key is here. The chemist on Fenwick Row is still open.

card.title: The Morse card
card.text: A quick tap is short. A long press is long.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: A quick tap is short. A long press is long.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Quick and long. Got it.

card.title: The message drawer
card.text: The drawer opens only to a signal copied from the lamp.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The drawer opens only to a signal copied from the lamp.

card.title: Telegram
views: A telegram was folded inside the drawer.
"Send the decoy trunk by the train after ten and before eleven. The Inspector will chase it."

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Send the decoy trunk by the train after ten and before eleven.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: A decoy! So the Inspector gets sent the wrong way.

objectiveCard.title: Chemist's Shop
objectiveCard.text: Clean the four stains from the study. Read the chart first.

enter.speaker: wren
enter.text: A chemist's shop. We have four samples from the study on this cloth.

enter.speaker: tobias
enter.text: Ink, clay, soot and wax. What do we do with them?

discuss.speaker: wren
discuss.text: Read the chart, then try a liquid on each stain.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: The ink is violet. That is the Bureau's own colour.

right.speaker: tobias
right.text: The ledger says only the Archive Office buys it, signed C. Hale.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: A left hand, a Bureau pass and violet ink all point to Hale. We still need proof.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: The chemist lends us a platform pass. The decoy trunk went by train.

card.title: The wall chart
card.text:
Lemon juice turns violet ink pale yellow.
Vinegar makes red clay fizz.
Soda water lifts soot into grey streaks.
Hot water melts candle wax away.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Each liquid works on only one stain.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Four liquids, four stains. No guessing.

card.title: The test cloth
card.text: Four stains from the study: ink, clay, soot and wax.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Four stains from the study: ink, clay, soot and wax.

card.title: The ledger
views: A heavy ledger lies open on the counter.
"Violet ink. Sold only to the Archive Office. Signed for: C. Hale."

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Violet ink. Sold only to the Archive Office. Signed for: C. Hale.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Mr. Hale is the archivist. And he writes with his left hand.

objectiveCard.title: Left-Luggage
objectiveCard.text: Find the locker the decoy trunk went into.

enter.speaker: wren
enter.text: The railway left-luggage hall. The decoy trunk started here.

enter.speaker: tobias
enter.text: Twenty lockers. I can count that high, but I am already worried.

discuss.speaker: wren
discuss.text: The telegram said after ten and before eleven. Which train is that?

discuss.speaker: tobias
discuss.text: Then we multiply for that train only.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: Five times three is fifteen. The locker opens.

right.speaker: tobias
right.text: A receipt signed C. Hale, and a stage-door card for the opera.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: Hale paid to send the decoy. Why does he need the opera? Let's find out.

card.title: The departure board
card.text:
9:40  Platform 3  4 carriages
10:15  Platform 5  3 carriages
11:05  Platform 2  6 carriages
11:50  Platform 4  5 carriages

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Four trains tonight. Each shows its platform and its carriages.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Platform and carriages. Carriages and platform.

card.title: The rule sign
card.text: Locker number = platform number x number of carriages.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Locker number equals platform number times number of carriages.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Multiplying. I brought my notebook.

card.title: The hatbox
views: A hatbox sits inside locker 15, with a stage-door card on top.
"Left-luggage receipt, one trunk, platform 5. Signed: C. Hale."

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: A receipt, signed C. Hale. And a stage-door card.

objectiveCard.title: Opera Backstage
objectiveCard.text: Send the lamp's light to the blank wall.

enter.speaker: wren
enter.text: The opera backstage. Mirrors, ropes and one very large lamp.

enter.speaker: tobias
enter.text: Why would a thief send us here?

discuss.speaker: wren
discuss.text: We turn the mirrors until the beam reaches the wall.

discuss.speaker: tobias
discuss.text: A lean right sends light up. A lean left sends it down.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: The false Bureau passes were printed at Marrow and Sons.

right.speaker: tobias
right.text: So the thief wanted into somewhere the Bureau guards.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: Cobb Street. Quick.

card.title: The stage lamp
card.text: The lamp shines east along the third row.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The lamp shines east along the third row.

card.title: The blank wall
card.text: The east wall is blank. Paint that waits for light.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The east wall is blank.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Paint that waits for light. Clever.

card.title: The glowing sign
views: Light reaches the wall and a painted sign glows.
"Marrow and Sons, Print Shop, Cobb Street. The false Bureau passes are printed here." It is in Voss's handwriting.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Marrow and Sons, Print Shop, Cobb Street. Passes printed here.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: That is the Professor's handwriting. He left us a trail.

objectiveCard.title: Print Shop
objectiveCard.text: Rebuild the torn letter and read what it says.

enter.speaker: wren
enter.text: A print shop. Fresh ink and a very long night.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: Vault. The Professor is in the vault below the Bureau.

right.speaker: tobias
right.text: And his seal opens the door.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: Hale has false passes but no seal. We can get there first.

card.title: Fresh passes
card.text: Dozens of Bureau passes, still wet. All false.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Dozens of Bureau passes, still wet. All false.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Hale made these to fool the guards.

card.title: Torn strips
card.text: Six strips of a letter, torn apart. They are in Voss's hand.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: A letter, torn in strips. It is in Voss's hand.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Six pieces. Let's put it back together.

preLines.speaker: voss
preLines.text: Very soon, someone will come for the Protocol.

preLines.speaker: voss
preLines.text: And I cannot let them have it.

preLines.speaker: voss
preLines.text: Under the Bureau, behind the old press room, I made a safe place.

preLines.speaker: voss
preLines.text: Look for the door that my seal opens.

preLines.speaker: voss
preLines.text: Trust Tobias; he reads more than he says.

preLines.speaker: tobias
preLines.text: He wrote those big first letters on purpose. An acrostic is a message hidden in first letters.

objectiveCard.title: The Sealed Vault
objectiveCard.text: Answer the four locks to open the case.

enter.speaker: wren
enter.text: The vault. The Professor must be near.

enter.speaker: tobias
enter.text: Four locks on that case. I hope we have the answers.

discuss.speaker: tobias
discuss.text: Our pages are in the Casebook. Let's read them first.

right.speaker: wren
right.text: Hale, the garden window, the 10:15 and Marrow and Sons.

right.speaker: tobias
right.text: That is the whole case. The case opens with a click.

card.title: The brass-bound case
card.text: Each lock is a sentence. Answer all four to open the case.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Each lock is a sentence. Answer all four to open the case.

street_key.text: Opens the telegraph office street door.

platform_pass.name: Platform pass

stage_door_card.name: Stage-door card
stage_door_card.text: A card that opens the opera stage door.

voss_seal.name: Voss's seal
voss_seal.text: Professor Voss's wax seal. It opens the stair to the vault.

casePages: The thief came in by the garden window, writes with the left hand, and works inside the Bureau.
A telegram says a decoy trunk goes on a train after ten and before eleven.
The ink on the glove is violet. The ledger shows only the Archive Office buys violet ink, signed C. Hale.
The 10:15 train from platform 5 carried the decoy trunk. The receipt in locker 15 is signed C. Hale.
The false Bureau passes were printed at Marrow and Sons Print Shop on Cobb Street.
Voss's letter says the real Protocol is safe in the vault below the Bureau, and his seal opens the door.

threat.speaker: tobias
threat.text: Careful! Hurry, we only have a few guesses left.

threat.speaker: wren
threat.text: Two wrong. Footsteps on the stairs. One more mistake and we are caught.

threat.speaker: hale
threat.text: Three wrong guesses. The Protocol is mine now, and you are done.

ending.speaker: voss
ending.text: Well done, Wren. I knew you would follow the trail.

ending.speaker: voss
ending.text: Safe, and so is the Protocol. I hid here when I saw Hale watching my desk.

ending.speaker: wren
ending.text: Hale. You came through the garden window and sent a decoy trunk on the 10:15.

ending.speaker: hale
ending.text: And you followed a trail of mirrors and ink. Impressive.

ending.speaker: wren
ending.text: Your false passes got you to the door, not through it.

ending.speaker: tobias
ending.text: The clock tower is striking. The inspectors' lanterns are on the stairs.

ending.speaker: voss
ending.text: The Protocol is safe. But this arrived at the Bureau tonight, addressed to you, Wren.

ending.speaker: wren
ending.text: A black wax seal. A gear with one tooth missing.

ending.speaker: voss
ending.text: Then there is a second lock.
